inputs.title: Bo and the Brave Step
inputs.logline: When worried young squirrel Bo keeps packing and unpacking for the Learning Circle, Keen and Aida help him discover that being afraid doesn’t mean you can’t still take the next step.

orderedEvents.text: Golden morning light. Dew sparkles on wildflowers. A honeycomb sits on a small stump. KEEN tiptoes toward it. He lifts his knees high with every step.
CRUNCH. CRUNCH. CRUNCH.
Keen freezes each time. He spots the honeycomb. His eyes widen. He LICKS HIS LIPS. He reaches toward the honey. FUZZBY the bee is asleep on top of the honeycomb.

orderedEvents.speaker: Fuzzby
orderedEvents.text: ZZZZZ …
A small snore bubble grows from his nose. Keen reaches closer to the honey. POP! The bubble bursts. Keen FREEZES.

orderedEvents.speaker: Fuzzby
orderedEvents.text: ZZZZZ …
Another bubble slowly grows. Keen inches closer to the honey.
POP! The second bubble bursts.

beats.storyBeat: Keen tries to steal a little honey with exaggerated stealth, but the scene’s real subject is how alive and playful this world is: even sleeping Fuzzby becomes an obstacle course of bubbles, timing, and temptation.
beats.want: Keen wants to get the honey without waking Fuzzby.
beats.need: He needs to learn that this world pushes back playfully, not cruelly — courage here begins in contact, not control.
beats.kidRead: Sneaky tiptoe honey mission.
beats.adultRead: A child testing the edges of rules in a world safe enough to tease him back.
beats.emotionalIntent: Playful suspense with tactile comic anticipation.

orderedEvents.text: Soft mist floats through tall trees. AIDA sits beside a crystal bowl. She slowly circles a mallet around the rim. A warm tone hums through the clearing. Her ROSE QUARTZ PENDANT begins to glow. Pink light fills her eyes.
VISION – THROUGH AIDA'S EYES
A small red squirrel sits inside a hollow tree. He packs a satchel. Unpacks it. Packs it again. He doesn't move. BACK TO SCENE. Aida gently stops the bowl. She places a paw on her heart.

beats.storyBeat: Aida’s bowl ritual slows the episode down and opens the feeling space; her vision reveals Bo alone in an anxious loop before anyone has met him, making his inner struggle the true call to action.
beats.want: Aida wants to understand who needs help.
beats.need: She needs to witness before she intervenes.
beats.kidRead: Magic vision shows a worried squirrel.
beats.adultRead: A caregiver noticing distress before the child can ask for help.
beats.emotionalIntent: Mystery, tenderness, and quiet purpose.

orderedEvents.text: Warm sunlight fills a cozy hollow tree. BO, a young red squirrel, sits beside a small satchel. Next to him lies a shiny CONKER. His Mum calls to him from offscreen, we never actually see his Mum.

orderedEvents.speaker: Bo's Mum
orderedEvents.text: BO, it’s time for you to go to the Learning Circle? Don’t forget your lunch.
Bo calls back to his Mum

orderedEvents.speaker: Bo
orderedEvents.text: I’ll go in a minute Mum.
(to the conker) Or forty. Forty sounds much better to me.

beats.storyBeat: Inside his tree home, Bo stalls with tiny rituals, talking himself into delay because leaving feels too big.
beats.want: Bo wants to postpone going to the Learning Circle.
beats.need: He needs permission to feel afraid without letting fear make the choice for him.
beats.kidRead: Bo doesn’t want to go yet.
beats.adultRead: An anxious child bargaining for more time because the outside world feels too exposed.
beats.emotionalIntent: Cozy but tense recognition.

beats.emotionalIntent: Sunny, liberating play with forward motion.
